workload.note: fused_experts with the arm's get_default_config (untuned GPU: no tuned JSON for RTX 5070 Ti): E=64 N=1408 K=2048 top_k=6 bf16, M in 1/16/128/1024/4096, CUDA-event us. policy.one_run_is: one `docker run` of the workload cmd per arm per repeat (same image, arm tree swapped in by the prelude)

arm_isolation.tree: wipe the wheel's vllm/*.py, copy the arm's vllm/ over site-packages (compiled .so stay)
arm_isolation.files: overlay ONLY metadata.json:source_files from the arm over the wheel's own tree

policy.noise_model: measure.py: paired log-speedup, MAD sigma, theta = clip(k*sigma, theta_min, theta_max) with k/theta from config.yaml:measure

author_hardware_args.text: Improve the default Triton fused MoE kernel configs when no tuned config file is available. The old defaults were chosen without much consideration: `BLOCK_SIZE_K=32` matched <1% of tuned configs, `num_warps`/`num_stages` were never set, an
Many-expert models see up to 2x speedup at large batch size with no regressions.
All numbers done on H100 with the new `benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_moe_defaults.py` script that include configs for common models to compare old, new, and tuned config.
